message: Lead inspected your uncommitted agent_execution_epoch legacy-drain schema/tests. Correct fail-closed default and durability. Important TOCTOU: TryAuthorizeLegacyDrain invokes verifyLegacyQuiescence BEFORE acquiring SQLite writer transaction / epoch state change. Between proof and commit, an old pre-witness request can be admitted/dispatched unless a real source-side exclusive admission/drain barrier is already held throughout. An empty witness table can't detect that. Before any Ready transition, require an authenticated, explicitly enforced legacy ingress/drain gate that blocks all pre-witness dispatches, across devices/restarts, and hold its exclusion from verification through durable epoch commit; reject old-protocol/unsupported clients rather than silently accepting ungated calls after approval. The current test's fun () -> Ok () is only a unit seam, not a production proof. Add deterministic barrier-race test (legacy request attempts dispatch during callback or after callback before commit), restart/rolling-upgrade test; don't wire a callable operator approval until these are satisfied. SQLite remains witness, Git state authority; no merges/deploy.
